name: Steam Coming Soon
description: Prepare an accurate, reviewable Steam Coming Soon store presence.

items.title: Create or confirm the Steamworks application
items.description: The store presence is managed from an application in Steamworks.
items.requirement: Confirm that the Steamworks application exists and that the team knows its App ID.

items.title: Complete store basic information
items.description: Customers and Steam review rely on accurate product and release information.
items.requirement: Complete the required store-presence fields and choose an honest release-date presentation.

items.title: Write the store descriptions
items.description: The short and full descriptions should explain the product clearly to a new player.
items.requirement: Provide coherent, accurate copy focused on this product and remove external links from description content.

items.title: Prepare compliant store capsule artwork
items.description: Capsule artwork represents the game throughout the Steam store.
items.requirement: Provide the required capsule artwork with a readable game title or logo and no disallowed marketing text.

items.title: Upload gameplay-only screenshots
items.description: Steam review expects screenshots to show the product customers will actually play.
items.requirement: Use screenshots of gameplay rather than concept art, pre-rendered stills, awards or marketing copy.

items.title: Prepare a gameplay trailer
items.description: A trailer is one of the first pieces of media a potential customer sees.
items.requirement: Prepare a trailer that gives viewers an honest view of the game and its core experience.

items.title: Verify that store claims match launch content
items.description: Store content should set accurate expectations for review and for customers.
items.requirement: Remove or clearly qualify screenshots, trailers and feature claims for content that will not be available at launch.

items.title: Plan Steam review and Coming Soon lead time
items.description: Steam review and the mandatory Coming Soon period need calendar space.
items.requirement: Allow at least seven business days for store review and plan for the Coming Soon page to be public for at least two weeks before playable release.

items.title: Define the audience and one-sentence promise
items.description: A clear positioning statement gives the whole store page one job.
items.requirement: Write down the target player, genre and one-sentence reason that player should care.

items.title: Align copy, screenshots and trailer
items.description: The main store assets should communicate the same core loop and value proposition.
items.requirement: Review the first visible copy and media together and remove contradictory or distracting messages.

items.title: Choose the store localization scope
items.description: Text-bearing artwork and store copy need a deliberate language plan.
items.requirement: List the languages that will be supported for store copy and identify artwork containing localizable text.

items.title: Run an outsider clarity review
items.description: Someone without project context can reveal unclear claims and missing steps.
items.requirement: Ask a reviewer unfamiliar with the project to identify what the game is, why it is interesting and what still appears incomplete.
